summary: Visible gains: the cairn pennants show up in the sandbox, the frame time is fine (3.7 ms median, 30 fps), and all plugins load. The flying lesson and the cairn flags are small and charming, but one new cairn pole stands in the camera's way and one test fails.
surprise_why: The flying lesson is a sweet new moment, but it is small, and the rest is fixes and polish.

findings.what: The cairn pennant poles are tall and stand in the frame. In my live screenshot of the follow camera on Lumi at the workbench, a thick pole with a red pennant runs through the middle of Lumi's body, and more poles and flags fill the foreground. The flag per 150 stones now clutters the camera views near the cairn, which cuts against the author's own camera work (#423).
findings.where: plugins/cairns.jl draw_flags!; screen: follow view at the workshop/cairn
findings.evidence: world/reviews/s71-a.png and s71-b.png (pole across Lumi, red pennants in the foreground)
findings.suggestion: Make the poles thinner and shorter, or count them as camera clutter so the follow camera moves around them. Check the view from the usual eye positions.

findings.what: The latest suite run ends with a failing test: 'Invitations: pairs that go flowers picking or shell hunting talk too'. Cumulus and Truffle never talked in 45 s (goals answer/answer, still paired: 0). The author blames other plugins, but the pout/shy change in presents.jl is in the same path.
findings.suggestion: Find out whether the pair is really preempted or the new refusal path drops it; fix the game, not the test.

findings.what: The friends' bodies (#236) are still only generated assets, and the flying lesson's every-20-30-min camera hold may crowd out other moments. In my two screenshots no lesson was running, so I could not confirm its look live beyond the author's film.
findings.suggestion: Cut the Snootle mesh into a species first thing next session; watch a whole lesson live.

agent_notes.cairn pennant poles in the camera's way: fixed s72: the top flag is 0.7 m (was 1.3 m) on a pole 0.015 thick (was 0.025), the pennants 0.45 m (was 0.75 m) on 0.01 poles, smaller pennants. Published 23:02.
agent_notes.failing invitation test: not the pout/shy change: that only runs on a refused invitation (yes = false), and both failures were after a yes or before any answer. The friends' goals ended 'answer/answer': tag.jl recruits free creatures, and an invitation pair on its way to a pastime counts as free; when the tag game ends its players get :answer hops (tag.jl end_tag!), so the pair is lost. The fix is to protect invitation pairs from recruiters (todo filed in s71, 'Invitation pairs keep their plan'), not to undo the pout.
agent_notes.friends' bodies only assets; lesson came: open: the Snootle and Blorbo meshes are ready for cutting into parts (#236, next session's main work). The lesson holds the camera only during the show, tries and the first 6 s of the ride (~20 s every 20-33 min).
